PC: Rapidly assesses airway, breathing, and circulation
Initiates patient monitoring (vital signs, cardiac monitor)
Secures the airway (when determined to be necessary for airway protection or a procedure)
Inserts or orders appropriate intravenous access (“two large-bore IVs”)

Initiates appropriate resuscitative techniques:
Intravenous fluids
Orders blood and blood products
Considers pharmacologic treatments (Examples: octreotide, antibiotics)

Orders appropriate labs; must include, at least, the following:
Type and cross match
Comprehensive metabolic panel (or basic metabolic with liver enzymes/hepatic panel)
Complete blood count
PT/INR

Considers gastroesophageal balloon tamponade (GEBT) device:
Follows steps outlined in the instruction sheet
Successfully inserts, checks, and inflates the device
Obtains x-rays to confirm placement of the device
MK: Recognize high risk chief complaint and potential for decompensation in upper gastrointestinal (UGI) bleeding.
Formulate a differential diagnosis of UGI bleeding.
Recognizes abnormal and unstable vital signs
SBP: Contact consultant(s): Gastroenterology and/or general surgery
